# Draft:Vintage King Audio

Vintage King Audio is a US-based pro audio online retailer and service provider of  vintage and modern audio equipment, including  mixing consoles, microphones, outboard gear,  audio interfaces, studio monitors, and more, with its headquarters located in the Detroit suburb of Troy, Michigan.
In addition to selling, Vintage King offers studio services, including  studio design, installation, patchbay wiring and configuration, and premium gear restoration. The Vintage King Tech Shop is one of the largest restoration shops for classic microphones, recording consoles, and studio electronics in the world.
From 2012 through 2025, the business also operated flagship showrooms in Los Angeles and Nashville.
History
Mike and Andrew Nehra established the company in 1993. The brothers had developed a love for classic analog recording equipment while working as professional musicians and producers in the late ‘80s and early ‘90s. They set up White Room Studios in downtown Detroit, where the centerpiece was an  API mixing console once owned by the Doobie Brothers.
As the studio grew, the brothers began searching for vintage gear to add to their collection. On a trip to the UK, they bought $8000 worth of gear. Once back in the US, they kept half the gear for the studio and sold the other half after servicing it to ensure it was in good working condition.
This period marked the early beginnings of Vintage King, and the brothers soon developed a reputation for professionalism, organisation, and bringing a feeling of security to the business of buying vintage gear.
In 1997, Dave Matthews enlisted the Nehras to build his new $500,000 mobile studio with a mix of vintage and modern components. This marked a turning point for Vintage King, and the company expanded its offerings beyond vintage equipment to also include new gear.
By 2001, Vintage King was recording $2 million in annual sales. The company also moved to a new location in Ferndale, Michigan. The Nehras decided to focus full-time on Vintage King and stepped away from their careers as professional musicians. With a staff of 10 at the Ferndale HQ, they spent the next decade building connections with pro audio equipment manufacturers and providing gear for artists and studios in the industry. Over the years, engineers and musicians like Bruce Springsteen, Jay Z, Lenny Kravitz, Billy Corgan, Will.I.Am, Bob Clearmountain, Michael Brauer, Chris Lord-Alge, Derek Trucks, Carl Craig, Aaron Dessner, and more have been customers.
In 2012, the Vintage King Tech Shop moved into an expanded facility. Located outside Detroit, Michigan, this became Vintage King's hub for servicing and restoring vintage gear. Items restored by Vintage King include mixing consoles used on work by Pink Floyd, Bob Marley and Led Zeppelin; a microphone from Motown's golden days; an audio compressor from the Beatles' Abbey Road Studios; and a pair of restored AMS Neve consoles, one for Lynyrd Skynyrd's studio in New Orleans and another for New York's famed Electric Lady Studios, later used on albums by Arcade Fire and Daft Punk.
That same year, Vintage King also opened a flagship Los Angeles showroom, followed by a Nashville location in 2013.
In 2017, Vintage King unveiled the brand’s new identity. The name was simplified from ‘Vintage King Audio’ to ‘Vintage King’; the logo retained the vacuum tube imagery, which represents the roots of Vintage King, but was redesigned and streamlined with an added pop of colour. The tagline ‘Pro Audio Outfitter’ was added to reflect the company’s goal of being a trusted guide and resource for audio professionals.
In 2018, Vintage King marked its 25th anniversary with a year-long celebration of the history of the company, the gear it had serviced over the years, and the customers that had become part of the VK family. Also in 2018, the company made the announcement that its Director of Business Development, Ryan McGuire, would be moving into a new role as the company’s President. Over his 12 years at Vintage King, McGuire rose through the ranks, from being one of Vintage King’s top sales consultants to founding and overseeing their distribution arm and leading the sales, marketing, and merchandising strategy of the company.
In 2020, Vintage King launched PLAYBACK, a print magazine wiith a digital edition that showcases the company’s expertise in all things pro audio with industry stories, gear reviews, behind-the-scenes features, and exclusive subscriber content.
In 2022, Vintage King moved into its new headquarters and warehouse in Troy, Michigan. The Vintage King HQ & Fulfillment Center is now Vintage King’s base of operation and, while not open to the public, it is sometimes the designated location for curbside pickups for customers who live in the area.
In 2023, Vintage King celebrated the company’s 30th anniversary with the 30 Years / 30 Studios series, featuring in-depth interviews with clients who were present from the start of their journey in 1993 and others who joined the fold over the years. Clients such as Eric Valentine, Michael Brauer, Bob Clearmountain, Carl Craig, Chris Coady, Ocean Way Nashville, Hyperballad Music, Belmont University, Prime Studio in Austria, and more, recounted their first impressions of Vintage King, favorite gear, how the industry has changed over the past 30 years, and what sets Vintage King apart from other pro audio gear companies.
In 2025, Vintage King Integration was launched to provide bespoke studio installation, gear, and audio consultation to facilities ranging from home studios to bigger commercial spaces. Also in 2025, Vintage King Audio announced the launch of a nationwide Try Before You Buy program, designed to give customers more immediate access to professional audio equipment, no matter where they are located. Through this program, the company is evolving how it delivers demos, consultations, and product experiences.
Tech Shop (Repair & Restoration)
From the company’s headquarters in Troy, Michigan, the Vintage King Tech Shop boasts a team of sonic preservationists with over 100 years of combined experience. The Tech Shop offers certified vintage restoration services and restores equipment to peak performance with a one-year warranty on the work, handling gear from Neve consoles to Neumann microphones and more. The blog series Around The Shop highlights some rare recoveries that have come through the Tech Shop doors.
Vintage King Integration
In 2025, Vintage King launched Vintage King Integration, a new division dedicated to providing world-class recording studio and live sound design, consulting, and installation services. Building on decades of successful installations, Vintage King Integration brings together an experienced team of designers, engineers, and technicians to deliver bespoke solutions for creators of all kinds, from boutique home studios to multi-room commercial facilities and performance venues. Notable installs include Blackbird Studio (Nashville); Studio Hikari (LA), Frostline Studios (Alaska), and Floki Studios (Iceland).
Vintage King Atlanta Studio Design Suite
Launched in 2025, the Atlanta Studio Design Suite at 800 East Studios gives audio professionals direct access to expert system design specialists and provides a space where creators can test cutting-edge equipment in a professional studio environment. Services offered include gear demos in a professionally treated space and meetings with experts for gear/studio consultation.
Community, Events & Media
Blog & Educational Content
The Vintage King Blog features new content weekly, including in-depth interviews, product reviews, gear spotlights, new launches, client stories, staff picks, buyer’s guides, and more.
Types Of Content
*Client Stories: Danny Reisch, Just Blaze, Aaron Dessner, Brothers Osborne, Damien Quintard, Derek Trucks, and Susan Tedeschi
*Studio Spotlight: Greylock Records, Hyperballad Music, Dweezil Zappa’s Hikari Studios, NOYZR Music,  Gojira's Silver Cord Studio
*VK Icons: John Storyk, Andrew Scheps, David Royer
*20 Questions: Catherine Marks, Sylvia Massy, John Rzeznik, Ken Caillat, Ryan Freeland, Chris Lord-Alge
PLAYBACK Magazine
Launched in 2020, PLAYBACK delivers in-depth gear reviews, exclusive interviews with award-winning audio engineers, and behind-the-scenes looks at studio installations. Available in digital and print formats,  producers and engineers featured include Just Blaze, Heba Kadry, Dweezil Zappa, Damien Lewis, Marcella Araica, Kristopher Pooley, Oak Felder, and more.
Pro Audio Events
Vintage King regularly hosts in-person events, designed to bring together small groups of engineers, producers, and music enthusiasts for hands-on experiences with essential studio gear. Past events include listening parties, gear showcases, open houses, and product launches featuring brands like Rupert Neve Designs, Solid State Logic, Barefoot Sound,  ATC,  Universal Audio, and more.
